title: json.load raises ValueError when dragging a file into a record
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Running Lattice 3.3.5 on Debian 12 against eu-west-2.

STEPS:

How to trigger it:
- Open Lattice and begin dragging a file into a record.
- Use a timestamp between 23:00 and 01:00 local time.
- Watch the log for the traceback below.

EXPECTED:

No traceback; dragging a file into a record normally takes a
few seconds.

ACTUAL:

The rejected value is a timestamp close to midnight. We are
in a timezone ahead of UTC; around midnight the date differs
from UTC.

FREQUENCY:

It occurs every time.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:46 in loop
lattice/ui/upload.py:39 in on_drop
lattice/io/upload.py:115 in send
lattice/io/json.py:181 in load
ValueError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
